title: Unary extension of an indexed language
statement: Let $p$ be a predicate on bit strings and natural numbers. Suppose that for every bit string $x$ and natural number $i$, $p(x,i)$ holds exactly when $x$ is the all-ones string of length $|x|$ and $p(x,i)$ holds. Let $q$ be a predicate on natural numbers, and suppose that for every natural numbers $n,i$, $p(1^n,i)$ holds exactly when $q(n,i)$ holds. Then the language of encodings $	ext{pairEncode}(x,	ext{bits}(i))$ satisfying $p(x,i)$ is exactly the language of encodings $	ext{pairEncode}(1^n,	ext{bits}(i))$ satisfying $q(n,i)$.
